# ===== PRESET: WARM RADIO (streamer/podcast style) =====
# Noise gate
VSTPlugin: Library "ATKExpander x64.dll" Attack 0.097959 Release 1 Threshold 0.499166 Softness 1 Slope 0.142134
Preamp: 11.5 dB
# Tight low cut: removes rumble so the warmth stays clean
Filter: ON HPQ Fc 90 Hz Q 0.707
# Chest resonance: the "close to the mic" radio richness
Filter: ON PK Fc 150 Hz Gain 3 dB Q 0.8
# Scoop the mud/box so the warmth doesn't turn muddy
Filter: ON PK Fc 400 Hz Gain -4.5 dB Q 1.0
# Soften nasal/honky headset tone
Filter: ON PK Fc 1000 Hz Gain -1.5 dB Q 1.2
# Wide, gentle presence: clear but smooth, not sharp
Filter: ON PK Fc 2500 Hz Gain 3 dB Q 0.6
# Tame headset edge/harshness
Filter: ON PK Fc 4500 Hz Gain -1.5 dB Q 2.0
# Compressor (steady, close sound) + de-esser
VSTPlugin: Library "TDR Kotelnikov.dll" ChunkData ""
VSTPlugin: Library reaxcomp-standalone.dll ChunkData "OAAAAAIAAAAAAAAAAHy1QAAAAAAAAPA/AAAAAAAA8D8AAAAAAADwPwAAAAAAAAAADwAAAJYAAAAFAAAAEAAAAAAAAAAAcNdAAAAAAAAA8D/qNoVLKampPwAAAAAAABBAAAAAAAAACEABAAAAMgAAAAUAAAAQAAAAAQAAAAEAAAAAAAAAAADwPwAAAAA="
